WITH r AS (INSERT INTO intel.runs (run_id, kind, as_of) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'daily', CURRENT_DATE) RETURNING run_id)
SELECT r.run_id::text AS run_id,
       (SELECT array_agg(ticker ORDER BY ticker) FROM intel.watchlist WHERE active) AS tickers,
       (SELECT array_agg(ticker ORDER BY ticker) FROM intel.watchlist WHERE active AND 'benchmark' = ANY(tags)) AS benchmarks,
       (SELECT array_agg(ticker ORDER BY ticker) FROM intel.watchlist WHERE active AND 'holding' = ANY(tags)) AS holdings,
       (SELECT value FROM intel.config WHERE key = 'weights') AS weights,
       COALESCE((SELECT value FROM intel.config WHERE key = 'notify_email'), 'true'::jsonb) AS notify_email,
       COALESCE((SELECT value FROM intel.config WHERE key = 'app_base_url'), '"http://app:8095"'::jsonb) #>> '{}' AS app_base_url,
       COALESCE((SELECT value FROM intel.config WHERE key = 'telegram'), '{"chat_id":"","send_document":true}'::jsonb) AS telegram,
       (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(p.ticker, jsonb_build_object('qty', p.qty, 'avg_cost', p.avg_cost)), '{}'::jsonb)
          FROM intel.positions p) AS positions,
       COALESCE((SELECT value FROM intel.config WHERE key = 'email_position_values'), 'false'::jsonb) AS email_position_values,
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM intel.api_usage WHERE source = 'alphavantage' AND status = 'ok' AND called_at::date = CURRENT_DATE) AS av_ok_today
FROM r;

SELECT w.ticker, w.tags, w.target_entry,
       p.close, p.volume,
       i.sma20, i.sma50, i.sma200, i.rsi14, i.atr14, i.vol_z20, i.hi52w, i.pct_from_hi52w, i.ret_1d, i.ret_5d, i.ret_20d,
       s.news_score, s.news_count,
       (SELECT round(avg(sentiment)::numeric, 3) FROM intel.news_articles n WHERE n.ticker = w.ticker AND n.sentiment IS NOT NULL AND n.published_at >= ($1::date - 37) AND n.published_at < ($1::date - 7)) AS sent_30d,
       (SELECT max(high) FROM intel.prices_daily q WHERE q.ticker = w.ticker AND q.as_of < $1::date AND q.as_of >= ($1::date - 30)) AS hi20_prev,
       (SELECT max(rsi14) FROM intel.indicators_daily r WHERE r.ticker = w.ticker AND r.as_of < $1::date AND r.as_of >= ($1::date - 30)) AS rsi20_prev_max,
       (SELECT json_build_object('as_of', f.as_of, 'pe', f.pe, 'ps', f.ps, 'pb', f.pb, 'rev_growth', f.rev_growth_yoy, 'rev_growth_q', f.rev_growth_q_yoy, 'eps_growth', f.eps_growth_yoy, 'gm', f.gross_margin, 'om', f.op_margin, 'de', f.debt_equity, 'cr', f.current_ratio, 'mcap', f.market_cap) FROM intel.fundamentals f WHERE f.ticker = w.ticker AND f.as_of <= $1::date AND f.as_of >= ($1::date - 14) ORDER BY f.as_of DESC LIMIT 1) AS fund,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM intel.news_articles n WHERE n.ticker = w.ticker AND n.published_at >= ($1::date - 37) AND n.published_at < ($1::date - 7)) AS cnt_30d,
       (SELECT json_build_object('buy_value', coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE tx_type = 'P'), 0), 'sell_value', coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE tx_type = 'S'), 0), 'buys', count(*) FILTER (WHERE tx_type = 'P'), 'sells', count(*) FILTER (WHERE tx_type = 'S')) FROM intel.insider_tx x WHERE x.ticker = w.ticker AND NOT coalesce(x.derivative, false) AND coalesce(x.tx_date, x.filed_at) > ($1::date - 90) AND coalesce(x.tx_date, x.filed_at) <= $1::date) AS insiders,
       (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('m', a.as_of, 'sb', a.strong_buy, 'b', a.buy, 'h', a.hold, 's', a.sell, 'ss', a.strong_sell) ORDER BY a.as_of DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM intel.analyst_recs a WHERE a.ticker = w.ticker AND a.as_of <= $1::date ORDER BY a.as_of DESC LIMIT 2) a) AS recs,
       (SELECT json_build_object('date', e.report_date, 'hour', e.hour, 'eps_est', e.eps_est) FROM intel.earnings_calendar e WHERE e.ticker = w.ticker AND e.report_date > $1::date ORDER BY e.report_date LIMIT 1) AS next_earnings,
       (SELECT json_build_object('date', e.report_date, 'surprise_pct', e.surprise_pct) FROM intel.earnings_calendar e WHERE e.ticker = w.ticker AND e.report_date <= $1::date AND e.eps_actual IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.report_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_earnings,
       (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('h', headline, 's', sentiment, 'u', url, 'src', source) ORDER BY published_at DESC) FROM (SELECT headline, sentiment, url, source, published_at FROM intel.news_articles n WHERE n.ticker = w.ticker AND n.published_at >= ($1::date - 2) ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 3) t) AS top_news
FROM intel.watchlist w
LEFT JOIN intel.prices_daily p ON p.ticker = w.ticker AND p.as_of = $1::date
LEFT JOIN intel.indicators_daily i ON i.ticker = w.ticker AND i.as_of = $1::date
LEFT JOIN intel.sentiment_daily s ON s.ticker = w.ticker AND s.as_of = $1::date
WHERE w.active
ORDER BY w.ticker;

INSERT INTO intel.scores_daily (ticker, as_of, momentum, value, sentiment, catalyst, composite, flags, risks, reasons, score_version, coverage)
SELECT ticker, as_of::date, momentum, value, sentiment, catalyst, composite, coalesce(flags, '{}'), coalesce(risks, '{}'), reasons, score_version, coverage
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(ticker text, as_of text, momentum numeric, value numeric, sentiment numeric, catalyst numeric, composite numeric, flags text[], risks text[], reasons jsonb, score_version text, coverage jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (ticker, as_of) DO UPDATE SET momentum = EXCLUDED.momentum, value = EXCLUDED.value, sentiment = EXCLUDED.sentiment, catalyst = EXCLUDED.catalyst, composite = EXCLUDED.composite, flags = EXCLUDED.flags, risks = EXCLUDED.risks, reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons, score_version = EXCLUDED.score_version, coverage = EXCLUDED.coverage;

parameters.content:
## Trigger + run context

Cron 0 6 * * 1-5, plus a POST webhook on stock-intel/run so the app's Run now button starts the same pipeline (header auth, responds immediately). One SQL opens a row in intel.runs and returns the active watchlist, benchmarks, holdings, weights and the delivery settings (app_base_url, telegram), so no node hardcodes a hostname or a chat. Alpaca calendar lists the last 14 days of sessions; Build context sets as_of to the last session whose 18:00 has passed, so a market holiday is never scored. If the calendar call fails it falls back to weekday math and the run is marked degraded.

## Collect

Six sub-workflows in sequence, each given the same context item: prices, indicators, news, earnings dates, fundamentals, signals (insiders + analyst recs). The Ctx nodes re-emit Build context because a sub-workflow returns its own counts, not the input.

## Score

One SQL joins watchlist, close, indicators, 7-day sentiment, a 30-day sentiment and article-count baseline, the prior 20-day high, top headlines, next and last earnings, the latest fundamentals snapshot, 90-day open-market insider flow and the last two months of analyst recs. Score v2 (JS) computes momentum, sentiment, growth-adjusted value and catalyst (earnings ahead, last surprise, news surge relative to the watchlist median that day, insider net flow, analyst buy share and its shift), each 0-100 and only where at least half its inputs exist; composite from the config weights renormalized over present components; entry flags (pullback-in-uptrend, oversold-bounce, breakout, near-target) and risk flags incl. earnings-soon at 7 days or less. Every row carries score_version and coverage. Stored in intel.scores_daily.

## Brief + Telegram

Markdown + HTML: market context, holdings, entry setups with evidence, watchlist table, risk flags, run footer. Build brief also sets the run status from what the collectors returned: ok, degraded (issues listed in runs.summary and the brief footer) or failed (nothing priced), and trims a short Telegram message (status, movers, setups, risks, issues) to fit the 4096-character cap. Telegram enabled? reads intel.config.telegram.chat_id: blank routes straight to the store and the brief stays in the app. Attach full brief? honours telegram.send_document; Brief to file turns the markdown into a .md attachment.

## Store + analyze

intel.reports gets the markdown and HTML copy and intel.runs is closed with a summary. reports.sent_to says 'telegram' only when the message node really ran without error, otherwise it stays empty. Analyze brief POSTs /api/reports/{as_of}/analyze to the app at intel.config.app_base_url (header auth); the analyst runs in the background and Today shows the result with citations. continueRegularOutput: an unreachable app never fails the run.

## Stock Intel: Daily

Personal research pipeline for your own watchlist. Framework, not advice; nothing here places orders.

**Runs** weekdays 06:00 in the instance timezone. as_of = last completed session, so Monday reports Friday.
**Reads/writes** Postgres `stocks`, schema `intel`, role stocks_n8n.
**Sub-workflows** Collect-Prices (Alpaca), Compute-Indicators (JS), Collect-News (Finnhub + Alpha Vantage), Collect-Earnings (Finnhub), Collect-Fundamentals (Finnhub), Collect-Signals (Finnhub insiders + recs). Each runs with continueRegularOutput: a dead source degrades the brief, never kills the run.
**Credentials** created from .env by scripts/bootstrap.py, named `Stock Intel ...`.
**Source** the stock-intel repo: sql/, workflows/, scripts/deploy_workflow.py. Edit the JSON in the repo and redeploy with the script, so the canvas and the file never drift.

## Quotas + watchlist

Free tiers per weekday: Finnhub ~250 of 86k, Alpha Vantage 22 of 25, Alpaca ~55 calls. Ledger: intel.api_usage, one row per call.

**Watchlist** = intel.watchlist where active, seeded from watchlist.yaml and edited in the app. Tags are yours; two are special: `benchmark` (priced and scored for context, never flagged) and `holding` (derived from Positions).
**Weights** intel.config key `weights`. Scores v2 use all four components.
